name: kamoca
description: Claude Code plugins from kamoca, grouped by domain (git, craft, design, docker).

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Atomic semantic commits with a body. A branch is required. Commits to main need an audited /git:main.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Requests as linear lists of verified items, ATDD, repository audits and refactor guided by SOLID, KISS, YAGNI, DRY and Clean Code, with entry skills that load focused reference files.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design systems, alternating background tokens, responsive mockups and complete screen states. Implementation follows explicit mockup approval. Includes pinned Impeccable guidance and optional Figma/FigCraft connectors.

plugins.name: docker
plugins.description: Docker environment with root-level base, dev and prod compose files and one Dockerfile per service in docker/<domain>/. Hooks enforce the rules. Tuning uses measurements. CI/CD on GitLab or GitHub.
